analysis: The only change in this PR is a test-only addition in provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/Service/ProviderModelSwitchTests.swift (head lines 683-687). Inside failedCommitPreservesMatchingHashAndFingerprint it adds assertions on loop.autopilotBusyReasons(): the .modelSwitch reason must be released after either failure, and .draining must remain only when the commit is unconfirmed (dropConnection). No production source is modified, so no trust boundary, key handling, attestation, encryption or authorization behavior changes. The assertions strengthen the fail-closed expectation that admission stays closed (state.refusingNewWork, .draining) when a models-replace commit is unconfirmed. This matches the TB-002 and T-053 intent that stale or unconfirmed state must not re-open serving. The base-side unit (lines 516-719) and the head units were compared and are otherwise identical apart from the 5-line shift. Remaining integration question, outside the supplied evidence: autopilotBusyReasons() and the production release of the .modelSwitch owner are not shown here, so whether production behavior matches the new assertions is not verified in this diff. That is a test-correctness matter, not a security regression. No findings.
